summary: Iteration 39 — Frontend e2e validation of /licences, /support (farmer), /support detail (reply), /admin-support, and PurchaseConfirmDialog wired into /marketplace. GuidedTour fix VERIFIED — tour no longer renders on /licences or /support (only /dashboard). 4/5 flows fully PASS. Marketplace dialog renders correctly and validates phone, but /api/marketplace-v2/purchase/initiate returns 404 'Produit introuvable' for legacy products → confirm step never reachable from UI (same backend issue flagged in iter 38, still not fixed).

critical.issue: Returns 404 'Produit introuvable' when called with product_id='prod_1' (the ID exposed by legacy GET /api/marketplace/products that the frontend Marketplace page uses). Verified live: clicking Acheter on 'Semences de Maïs Hybride' → fills phone 237670000000 → click Continuer → backend 404 logged in browser console. Dialog displays the error and the user cannot reach the 'Confirmer et payer' step. Iter 38 already flagged this; the fix described in 'other_misc_info' (price_per_unit fallback) does not address product LOOKUP — products from legacy in-code list are not seeded into MongoDB. Fix path: on backend startup, upsert the hardcoded product list into db.marketplace_products with normalized 'price' field, OR have marketplace_v2.initiate_purchase fall back to look up products from the same source that powers /api/marketplace/products.

ui_bugs.issue: Reply textarea and send button are missing data-testid='reply-textarea' and data-testid='send-reply-btn' attributes (they exist on /support farmer page but not on /admin-support). Tests have to fall back to generic selectors. Add the same testids for parity and to allow shared regression scripts.

integration_issues.issue: Initiate POST returns 404; confirm step never displays the 'Confirmer et payer' button. Cancel + close work fine. End-to-end purchase flow is unreachable until backend product lookup is fixed.

action_items: MUST FIX (CRITICAL): Marketplace V2 product lookup. /api/marketplace-v2/purchase/initiate must resolve product_id='prod_1' (and prod_2..prod_8 served by /api/marketplace/products). Either (a) seed the hardcoded list into MongoDB on startup, or (b) make initiate_purchase delegate lookup to the in-memory list of /api/marketplace/products. This is the SAME bug from iter 38 — it blocks the entire marketplace purchase UX.
SHOULD FIX (MEDIUM): Add data-testid='reply-textarea' and data-testid='send-reply-btn' to the AdminSupport ticket-detail dialog reply controls (parity with /support page).

context_for_next_testing_agent: GuidedTour fix is VERIFIED. /licences, /support, /admin-support flows all green end-to-end. The ONLY remaining bug is the marketplace_v2 product lookup 404 — same root cause as iter 38: legacy /api/marketplace/products serves hardcoded mocks (prod_1..prod_8) NEVER persisted to MongoDB, so /api/marketplace-v2/purchase/initiate cannot find them. Main agent should either seed marketplace_products on startup or refactor initiate to share the legacy product source. After that fix, retest /marketplace flow only — everything else is clean.
rca of the issue: Marketplace 'Produit introuvable' RCA: Browser console + network tab confirm POST /api/marketplace-v2/purchase/initiate {product_id:'prod_1', quantity:1, ...} returns HTTP 404. Backend marketplace_v2.initiate_purchase reads via db.marketplace_products.find_one({'id': product_id}) and falls back to db.products.find_one(...) — both miss because /api/marketplace/products serves an in-code Python list that is never inserted into MongoDB. The IDs 'prod_1'..'prod_8' exist only in the legacy endpoint's response. Fix: insert the hardcoded list into db.marketplace_products on backend startup (idempotent upsert with normalized 'price' field), OR pass product objects via session/cache rather than re-resolving by id.
